CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, February 18, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE NOVEMBER 19, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  February 18, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, November 19, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:03 P.M. on Wednesday, November 19, 2025 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall,
111 South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Love.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Navarro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Boettcher,
and Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE OCTOBER 15, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Love, the
October 15, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

TAM STUDIO: 726 EAST MAIN STREET PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL
The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission recommend approval of the proposed mural with
an addition of a snowcapped mountain to represent Mount Baldy to the Planning Commission.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
Commission Member Hermano shared a $4,600 quote from BuzzHiveCreative for design, print,
and installation for ten utility boxes and will return to the next meeting with a quote for
materials.

STAFF REPORT
The City Art and Cultural Events Commission approved Keith Batcheller to exhibit paintings in
the Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery for the month of February 2026.

Recreation Supervisor Boettcher invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission and their families to vote in the upcoming Holiday Home Decorating Contest.

Director Macias reported that all volunteers that assist with this year’s rose parade float
decoration will receive a free long sleeve t-shirt with the 2026 Alhambra float rendering on the
back;165 volunteers signed up for dry and floral decoration shifts as of 11/19/25.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.
 COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission will not meet in December due to the holidays
and the next meeting is scheduled for January 21, 2026.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Hermano, the
November 19, 2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:54
P.M.
